records.name: Canva Craft

officialStatus.craft: Canva Craft is its first-party image-generation model, currently exposed as craft_v1_2k through the preview Image Generation API. It requires OAuth on behalf of the user, asset:write scope and the image_generation capability; each generation consumes the user's AI credit allowance.
officialStatus.previewLimits: The API is explicitly in preview; apps using it cannot pass public-app review or be made available to all Canva users.
officialStatus.mcpDistinction: Canva MCP is a separate integration. Its developer announcement dated 2026-10-27 says it can be enabled in the Developer Portal using a per-user OAuth client; service-account authentication is not supported. Some capabilities require a paid Canva plan.

records.decision: Do not import: exact ID/URL absent from current Feed. Keep Seen-only; do not create a replacement ID. Do not conflate the Craft image-generation preview API with the separate Canva MCP server.

records.name: 1Password agent sign-in

officialStatus.availability: Opt-in feature for Individual and Family accounts on 1Password.com; Teams/Business and 1Password.ca/.eu are not currently supported.
officialStatus.requirement: 1Password app version 8.12.42 or later on the same device; currently supported agents are listed in the official support article.
officialStatus.authorization: The user approves each new item request; the agent cannot approve its own request. An approved item can be reused for up to 30 days and access can be revoked.
officialStatus.boundary: 1Password fills and submits the sign-in form outside the agent's view. After sign-in, the website session is governed by the agent; 1Password's guarantees do not cover the agent's later actions on the website.

records.decision: Do not import: exact ID/URL absent from current Feed. Keep Seen-only; do not create a replacement ID.
